title: Population size and selection sensitivity

sign_policy.interpretation: excitatory and inhibitory are modelling priors applied to the presynaptic neuron; they are not established postsynaptic effects at every target

weight_policy.weight_source: integer synapse count (`count`); `norm` is never used
weight_policy.interpretation: weights are structural synapse counts raised to a monotone transform and scaled to pA; they are not conductances

provenance.node_order: ascending banc_888_id, identical to graph root_ids
provenance.unknown_edges: excluded from propagation; they contribute zero current

provenance.source: Phase 4D BANC v888 node table (annotations only)

definitions.LEFT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'left' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.RIGHT: super_class == 'motor' and side == 'right' and body_part_effector in ['front_leg', 'middle_leg', 'hind_leg'] and not a tergotrochanter candidate
definitions.UNASSIGNED: motor neurons not covered by LEFT, RIGHT or JUMP
definitions.ROLL: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
definitions.DUCK: unsupported: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.overlap_policy: tergotrochanter candidates are also leg motor neurons; by default they are removed from LEFT/RIGHT so the action populations are disjoint and JUMP activity is not double-counted

unsupported_actions.ROLL: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a roll motor population; a roll signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.
unsupported_actions.DUCK: No published BANC annotation in this export defines a duck or crouch motor population; a duck signal would need evidence not present in the structural tables.

provenance.scientific_status: LEFT, RIGHT and JUMP are decoder labels derived from published effector annotations. They are not identified biological motor commands.

design.seed_rule: 20261109 + 200000 + 1000*size + 10*rule_ordinal + draw_index; rule ordinals follow the order of RULES
design.pool_exclusion: random rules draw from the eligible VNC-intrinsic pool with the 64 condition C neurons removed, matching 4H.1 family A
design.confirmatory_comparison: one: size 64 connectivity_ranked versus 100 family A draws
design.exploratory_note: all other size and rule comparisons are descriptive; degree is a structural graph property and is not given a biological interpretation

reference.label: 4H1_reference_C
reference.phase_4g_decision_hash_note: Phase 4G hashes its own window-record schema; the 4H decision hash is over ActionDecision dicts and is not byte-comparable

jump_pool_analysis.null_model: per run: JUMP active fraction against 10,000 seeded 20-neuron subsets of the 805 motor neurons, and against 10,000 seeded 20-neuron subsets of the 371 leg (LEFT+RIGHT) motor neurons

confirmatory.comparison: size 64 connectivity_ranked (the Phase 4G condition C candidate set) versus the 100 Phase 4H.1 family A draws
confirmatory.note: The same test is also reported in the 4H.1 result file; it is repeated here for the size-sensitivity question and is not counted twice.

runtime.execution_note: the surface may be assembled from a resumed checkpoint; sum_run_wall_time_s is the summed duration of the 175 stored runs, while assembly_wall_time_s covers only this invocation

limitations: Ranked rules are deterministic and run once, so they carry no sampling uncertainty; only random rules quantify variability.
Degree is a structural property of the threshold-5 graph; no biological meaning is assigned to in-, out- or combined degree.
The eligible pool is fixed by the Phase 4F verified-excitatory policy; unverified or inhibitory neurons are outside this surface.
The JUMP null model reuses motor spike counts from one run and tests pool size and identity, not biological recruitment.
A single pre-registered confirmatory comparison is made at size 64; the rest of the surface is exploratory and not corrected.
